name: Ancient Jericho/Tell es-Sultan
description: Tell es-Sultan is a grassy mound just north of modern Jericho in the Jordan Valley, built up from layers of human settlement beside a spring that still flows. Around 9,000 years ago, its people were already living in a walled town with a ditch and a stone tower. Later layers show Bronze Age planning and a large Canaanite city with massive ramparts.
